Interface IObservable

All Known Implementing Classes:
EventNotificationService
public interface IObservable
Defines the contract for any class that can be observed.

Forms part of the Observer pattern implementation.

  • Method Details

    • attach

      boolean attach(IObserver observer)
      Attaches, or subscribes, an observer to this observable object, meaning it will receive notifications whenever the target event is updated.
      Parameters:
      observer - The observer to attach to this observable object.
      Returns:
      true if the observer was attached; false if the observer was already attached to begin with.

    • detach

      boolean detach(IObserver observer)
      Dettaches, or unsubscribes, an observer from this observable object, meaning it will no longer receive notifications if the target event gets updated.
      Parameters:
      observer - The observer to detatch from this observable object.
      Returns:
      true if the observer was detached; false if the observer wasn't attached to begin with.

    • notifyObservers

      void notifyObservers(NotificationType reason)
      Notifies every attached observer of a change to the given event.

      Called by the observable whenever an Event is updated, fanning the change out to each IObserver currently attached.

      The order in which observers are notified is not guaranteed.

      If no observers are attached, this method is a no-op.

      Forms part of the Observer pattern implementation.

      Parameters:
      reason - the type of change to the event; the reason why the notification is being sent.
      See Also:
      • IObserver
      • attach(IObserver)
      • detach(IObserver)
